title: Nayab Tehsildar, Excise Inspector and More
summary: The Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) has announced a recruitment notification for 54 posts including Nayab Tehsildar and Excise Inspector. Interested eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal by the deadline of November 26, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must hold a Bachelors degree from a recognized university.
Must meet the age criteria specified in the official notification.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Nayab Tehsildar, Excise Inspector and More

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official UKPSC website at https://ukpsc.net.in/
Navigate to the recruitment notification section for the Lower Subordinate Service Examination 2026.
Complete the online application form and submit the required details before the deadline.
